project.name: auki-sdk
project.description: On-device SDK for the Auki spatial-computing protocol — a Cargo workspace of Rust crates plus per-language bindings (Python via PyO3, Swift via UniFFI, TypeScript for the browser)

nodes.name: membership_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the MembershipUpdate message (manager peer ID + membership JSON) and length-prefixed JSON framing functions for broadcasting cluster membership changes to connected peers.

nodes.name: MembershipUpdate
nodes.summary: Carries the manager's peer ID and the full cluster membership JSON for distribution to peers after a membership change.

nodes.name: write_membership_update
nodes.summary: Serializes a MembershipUpdate to JSON with a big-endian u32 length prefix and writes it to an async stream.

nodes.name: read_membership_update
nodes.summary: Reads a length-prefixed membership update from an async stream, enforcing frame size limits and deserializing from JSON.

nodes.name: network_runtime.rs
nodes.summary: Core network runtime that drives the libp2p swarm event loop: manages peer connections, heartbeat tasks, join/info/resources/registry protocol handlers, membership broadcast, and stream subscriptions for audio, camera, point-cloud, joint-encoders, and detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tokio channels (mpsc + oneshot) for command/response communication between the public NetworkRuntime handle and the internal async task. Connected peer set is wrapped in Arc<Mutex> for cross-thread access.

nodes.name: NetworkRuntime
nodes.summary: Primary handle to the running network: exposes join, info, resources, registry request methods; membership and diagnostic broadcast; heartbeat target management; stream opening; and shutdown.

nodes.name: NetworkRuntimeHandle
nodes.summary: Lightweight cloneable handle to the runtime's command channel, exposing a subset of runtime operations for use in other tasks without taking ownership of the full runtime.

nodes.name: JoinEvent
nodes.summary: Emitted when a peer requests to join: carries the peer ID, join request payload, and a oneshot sender for the manager to acknowledge.

nodes.name: PeerLivenessEvent
nodes.summary: Events emitted by the heartbeat subsystem: peer connected, disconnected, heartbeat received, NTP sample observed, or heartbeat stream closed.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Creates a new NetworkRuntime by spawning the internal swarm event-loop task and returning a handle with all event receiver channels.

nodes.name: run_task
nodes.summary: Main async loop driving the libp2p swarm: polls swarm events, processes inbound protocol substreams, handles runtime commands, and manages heartbeat task lifecycle.

nodes.name: handle_event
nodes.summary: Dispatches a single swarm event: handles connection established/closed events, routes inbound protocol substreams, and manages heartbeat task creation and cleanup.

nodes.name: apply_peer_update
nodes.summary: Applies a new allowed-peer list: disconnects removed peers, adds newly known peers to the dial schedule, and updates the connected-peers set for peers already reachable.

nodes.name: participant.rs
nodes.summary: Defines ParticipantInfo, the rich data-transfer object describing a participant in a session with sensor catalog, pose, capabilities, and media presence fields.

nodes.name: ParticipantInfo
nodes.summary: Comprehensive description of a session participant: peer ID, app ID, display name, role flags, sensor metadata, pose data, capabilities, and media presence.

nodes.name: registries_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the registry lookup protocol: RegistryKind enum, request/response/envelope types, and protobuf framing functions for querying named registries on remote peers.

nodes.name: RegistryRequest
nodes.summary: Request message for querying a specific registry kind and entry key on a remote peer.

nodes.name: RegistryKind
nodes.summary: Enum enumerating supported registry types (e.g., SensorCatalog, PoseRegistry) with string conversion for wire representation.

nodes.name: resources_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the resources catalog protocol: ResourcesRequest/Response types with rich sensor and pose manifest descriptors, plus protobuf framing for querying a peer's available streams.

nodes.name: ResourcesRequest
nodes.summary: Request to retrieve a peer's resources catalog, with an 'all' convenience constructor.

nodes.name: ResourceEntry
nodes.summary: A single resource entry in the catalog, combining a sensor/pose variant descriptor with its availability metadata.

nodes.name: stream_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the stream subscription protocol: StreamRequest/ReadFrom types, wire encoding/decoding for stream negotiation, and message framing for length-prefixed binary stream entries.

nodes.name: StreamRequest
nodes.summary: Negotiation request sent when opening a sensor stream subscription, carrying the manifest pointer and read-from position.

nodes.name: stream_runtime.rs
nodes.summary: Manages sensor stream dispatch and subscription lifecycle: accepts inbound stream substreams, multiplexes entries to consumers via tokio broadcast channels, and handles back-pressure and error propagation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tokio::sync::broadcast per stream type for fan-out to multiple consumers; stream entries are pumped from the network in a dedicated task.

nodes.name: StreamDispatch
nodes.summary: Central dispatch table mapping stream IDs to broadcast senders, enabling multiple subscribers to receive frames from the same sensor stream.

nodes.name: StreamSubscription
nodes.summary: Consumer-side subscription handle returned when opening a stream; yields StreamItem values as they arrive from the remote peer.

nodes.name: open_stream
nodes.summary: Opens a new sensor stream to a remote peer: negotiates the stream protocol, sends a StreamRequest, and registers a broadcast receiver for incoming frames.

nodes.name: handle_inbound_substream
nodes.summary: Handles an inbound stream substream: reads the StreamRequest, validates the manifest, and spawns a pump task to forward frames to all subscribers.

nodes.name: swarm.rs
nodes.summary: Builds and configures the libp2p Swarm with all network behaviours (relay, identify, connection limits, stream protocols), and provides dial, relay reservation, and circuit-address utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Assembles multiple libp2p behaviours via NetworkBehaviour derive; relay circuit reservation uses a state machine with timeout polling.

nodes.name: Behaviour
nodes.summary: Composite libp2p NetworkBehaviour combining relay client, identify, connection-limits, and stream protocol handlers for the Auki network swarm.

nodes.name: build_swarm
nodes.summary: Constructs the full libp2p Swarm from a SwarmConfig and PeerIdentity, wiring all transport layers and behaviours together.

nodes.name: reserve_relay_circuit_addr_with_advertised_addr
nodes.summary: Dials a relay peer, waits for a circuit reservation, and returns the reserved circuit multiaddress for advertising to the discovery service.

nodes.name: app_instance.rs
nodes.summary: Derives a stable application instance ID from the local machine's MAC addresses, filtering loopback and locally-administered MACs to produce a deterministic 12-hex-char string.

nodes.name: derive
nodes.summary: Collects system MAC addresses and derives an app instance ID, returning a DeriveError if no suitable MAC is found.

nodes.name: derive_from
nodes.summary: Derives an app instance ID from a provided slice of raw MAC address bytes, filtering unsuitable MACs and returning the lexicographically smallest candidate.

nodes.name: DeriveError
nodes.summary: Error enum for app instance ID derivation failures: no network interfaces, no suitable MAC, or an I/O error.

nodes.name: browser_probe.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a WebRTC-direct probe server for browsers: builds a libp2p swarm with WebRTC transport and exposes a request-response probe protocol to identify the native-side peer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses libp2p SwarmBuilder with WebRTC direct transport and the libp2p-stream behaviour alongside request-response.

nodes.name: listen_and_serve
nodes.summary: Starts the browser probe swarm, listens on the given multiaddress, and serves BrowserProbeResponse messages to incoming browser requests.

nodes.name: build_browser_probe_swarm
nodes.summary: Constructs a libp2p Swarm configured with WebRTC direct transport, request-response probe behaviour, and stream behaviour for the browser probe service.

nodes.name: BrowserProbeBehaviour
nodes.summary: Composite libp2p NetworkBehaviour combining the probe request-response handler and a stream behaviour for the browser probe server.

nodes.name: BrowserProbeError
nodes.summary: Error variants for the browser probe server: transport setup, listen, and listen timeout failures.

nodes.name: browser_probe_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the request and response message types for the browser probe protocol, with a constructor that echoes the request nonce and payload back while naming the responder peer.

nodes.name: BrowserProbeRequest
nodes.summary: Request message for the browser probe protocol carrying a nonce and arbitrary payload.

nodes.name: BrowserProbeResponse
nodes.summary: Response message for the browser probe protocol that echoes the nonce and payload and includes the responder's peer label.

nodes.name: browser_session_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the full browser session protocol: client/server message enums covering session lifecycle, roster snapshots, and sensor subscriptions, plus length-prefixed JSON framing functions for async streams.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a big-endian u32 length prefix followed by a JSON body; max frame size capped to guard against runaway allocations.

nodes.name: BrowserSessionClientMessage
nodes.summary: Enum of client-to-server messages for a browser session: Hello, UpdateParticipant, SetSensorPublication, Subscribe, Unsubscribe, Leave.

nodes.name: BrowserSessionServerMessage
nodes.summary: Enum of server-to-client messages for a browser session: Snapshot (roster), Ack, and Error.

nodes.name: BrowserRosterSnapshot
nodes.summary: Snapshot of the session roster sent to browsers: includes self peer ID, domain name, manager peer ID, election state, and participant list.

nodes.name: write_client_message
nodes.summary: Serializes and length-prefixes a BrowserSessionClientMessage to an async write stream.

nodes.name: read_server_message
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes a length-prefixed BrowserSessionServerMessage from an async read stream.

nodes.name: diagnostic_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the diagnostic message type and length-prefixed JSON framing for transmitting diagnostic payloads (topic + JSON body) over async streams between peers.

nodes.name: DiagnosticMessage
nodes.summary: Carries a diagnostic topic string and a JSON payload string for peer-to-peer diagnostic broadcasting.

nodes.name: write_diagnostic_message
nodes.summary: Serializes a DiagnosticMessage to JSON and writes it with a big-endian u32 length prefix to an async write stream.

nodes.name: read_diagnostic_message
nodes.summary: Reads a length-prefixed diagnostic message from an async stream, enforcing a max frame size and deserializing JSON.

nodes.name: discovery_client.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP client for the Auki discovery service: registers, lists, updates, and deregisters domain clusters; handles relay multiaddr derivation from circuit addresses.

nodes.name: DiscoveryClient
nodes.summary: Async HTTP client wrapping reqwest that manages cluster registration, liveness checks, manager rotation, and deregistration against the discovery REST API.

nodes.name: ClusterEntry
nodes.summary: Represents a registered domain cluster with manager peer ID, multiaddrs, relay multiaddrs, peer count, and timestamps.

nodes.name: create_cluster
nodes.summary: Registers a new domain cluster via POST to the discovery API, returning Created or AlreadyExists outcomes.

nodes.name: rotate_manager
nodes.summary: Updates the cluster manager peer ID and multiaddrs in the discovery service after a manager promotion.

nodes.name: parse_wire_entry
nodes.summary: Converts a raw WireClusterEntry (string-typed fields) into a typed ClusterEntry, validating peer IDs and multiaddresses.

nodes.name: heartbeat_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Heartbeat message structure (with NTP-echo and domain-clock fields) and length-prefixed JSON framing functions for peer-to-peer heartbeat streams.

nodes.name: Heartbeat
nodes.summary: Message carrying heartbeat timing data including sender's clock ID/hash, sequence number, unix timestamp, and optional NTP echo and domain-clock fields.

nodes.name: HeartbeatDomainClock
nodes.summary: Domain-clock piggyback carried in heartbeats: reports cluster name, domain and backing clock IDs, hashes, and the backing-to-domain offset in nanoseconds.

nodes.name: write_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Serializes a Heartbeat to JSON and writes it with a big-endian u32 length prefix to an async write stream.

nodes.name: read_heartbeat
nodes.summary: Reads a length-prefixed heartbeat message from an async stream, enforcing frame size limits and deserializing JSON.

nodes.name: info_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the peer info request/response protocol using protobuf framing: read/write functions for InfoRequest and InfoResponse messages over async streams.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses protobuf encoding (prost Message::encode/decode) unlike the JSON framing used by other protocols in this crate.

nodes.name: write_info_response
nodes.summary: Serializes an InfoResponse to protobuf and writes it length-prefixed to an async stream.

nodes.name: read_info_response
nodes.summary: Reads and protobuf-decodes a length-prefixed InfoResponse from an async stream.

nodes.name: join_protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the peer join protocol: JoinRequest (with multiaddrs) and JoinResponse (Accept/Reject) types, protobuf framing, and conversion functions between domain types and wire protobufs.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes domain types with generated protobuf types; explicit proto_from/from_proto conversion functions keep the boundary clear.

nodes.name: JoinRequest
nodes.summary: Carry a list of multiaddresses sent by a joining peer to identify its reachable endpoints.

nodes.name: JoinResponse
nodes.summary: Manager's response to a join request: either Accept (with membership JSON and successor token) or Reject (with a reason string).

nodes.name: write_join_request
nodes.summary: Converts a JoinRequest to its protobuf form and writes it length-prefixed to an async stream.

nodes.name: read_join_response
nodes.summary: Reads a length-prefixed protobuf JoinResponse from an async stream and converts it to the domain JoinResponse type.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for auki-network: re-exports all submodules and defines the top-level PeerIdentity (ed25519 keypair wrapper), SessionHandle, ReachabilityRecord, and Capability types used throughout the SDK.

nodes.name: PeerIdentity
nodes.summary: Wraps a libp2p ed25519 Keypair to represent a peer's cryptographic identity, providing peer_id(), public_key(), and construction from seed bytes or a wallet.

nodes.name: ReachabilityRecord
nodes.summary: Records a peer's known multiaddresses, declared capabilities, and last-seen nanosecond timestamp for reachability tracking.

nodes.name: Capability
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapping a capability string in namespace/name format, with accessor methods for namespace and string representation.

nodes.name: from_seed
nodes.summary: Constructs a PeerIdentity deterministically from a 32-byte seed by creating an ed25519 secret key and wrapping it in a libp2p Keypair.

nodes.name: contract.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying the type contracts and constant exports defined in contract.ts, including SDK_SENSOR_KINDS and SDK_STREAM_STATES.

nodes.name: contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the core SDK type contracts, including the BrowserDomainPeer interface, sensor kinds (SDK_SENSOR_KINDS), and stream state constants (SDK_STREAM_STATES) shared across the auki-domain-browser crate.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript type definitions and constants with no external imports — serves as the single source of truth for the public SDK contract.

nodes.name: controlProtocol.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the binary control protocol codec (join, info, stream messages), exercising encode/decode round-trips defined in protocol/control.ts.

nodes.name: discovery.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the listDomains discovery function, covering HTTP fetch success and error paths.

nodes.name: discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the listDomains function that queries a discovery URL to retrieve available Auki domains, returning a typed Result with detailed error codes.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Provides Result-type factory helpers (ok, fail, transportUnavailable) used throughout the SDK to wrap successes and typed errors into a uniform return type.

nodes.name: identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the identity utilities — seed loading, derivation, and peer ID generation functions in identity.ts.

nodes.name: identity.ts
nodes.summary: Implements cryptographic peer identity utilities: loading or creating persistent seeds, deriving deterministic peer seeds via xxhash128, generating libp2p peer IDs from seeds, and raw byte helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses xxhash128 for deterministic seed derivation and libp2p's generateKeyPairFromSeed for Ed25519 key generation — no external imports at the module level (all crypto deps imported inline).

nodes.name: installGlobal.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying that installAukiBrowserPeer correctly registers a peer factory on the global window object.

nodes.name: installGlobal.ts
nodes.summary: Exports installAukiBrowserPeer, which attaches a peer factory function to the global window object so browser environments can access the SDK without module bundlers.

nodes.name: jsLibp2pPeer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration-style tests for JsLibp2pBrowserPeer including in-memory transport/network stubs (MemoryNetwork, MemoryTransport, QueueStream) to simulate peer connection, joining, and sensor workflows.

nodes.name: jsLibp2pPeer.ts
nodes.summary: Core browser peer implementation using js-libp2p: manages domain join/leave, participant observation, sensor declaration and audio streaming, membership refresh, and the underlying WebSockets/WebRTC/circuit-relay transport lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: 819-line class-heavy module combining libp2p lifecycle management with Auki domain protocol logic; Libp2pBrowserPeerTransport wraps js-libp2p node and JsLibp2pBrowserPeer implements the SDK BrowserDomainPeer contract.

nodes.name: peer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the high-level createBrowserDomainPeer factory and session-wrapping logic, covering SDK-session delegation, fallback closed-peer behavior, and snapshot update flows.

nodes.name: peer.ts
nodes.summary: High-level browser peer factory that composes the libp2p implementation with SDK-session delegation and closed-peer fallback, exposing a single createBrowserDomainPeer entry point that handles both native and global-factory instantiation paths.

nodes.name: control.ts
nodes.summary: Hand-written binary protocol codec for the Auki control plane: defines protobuf-style message types (JoinRequest/Response, InfoRequest/Response, StreamMessage, AudioData) with encode/decode methods, plus frame framing utilities (writeFrame, readFrame) and low-level ProtoWriter/ProtoReader classes.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a custom protobuf-compatible binary wire format without protoc-generated code — ProtoWriter and ProtoReader directly encode/decode varint, bytes, and string fields for zero-dependency browser use.

nodes.name: listDomains
nodes.summary: Queries a discovery service URL to list available Auki domains, validating the HTTP response and returning a typed Result array of domain records.

nodes.name: loadOrCreateSeed
nodes.summary: Loads an existing peer seed from a seed store or generates and persists a new one using the provided randomSeed function.

nodes.name: memorySeedStore
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory seed store with optional initial seed value, implementing the SeedStore interface for testing or ephemeral peer identities.

nodes.name: peerIdFromSeed
nodes.summary: Derives a deterministic libp2p peer ID string from a raw seed by running derivePeerSeed then generating an Ed25519 key pair.

nodes.name: derivePeerSeed
nodes.summary: Derives a 32-byte deterministic peer seed from a parent seed and a label string using xxhash128 double-hashing.

nodes.name: createJsLibp2pBrowserPeer
nodes.summary: Factory that instantiates a JsLibp2pBrowserPeer from provided options including seed store, discovery URL, and optional relay multiaddrs.

nodes.name: createBrowserLibp2pTransport
nodes.summary: Creates and configures a libp2p node for browser use with WebSockets, WebRTC, WebRTC-Direct, and circuit-relay transports, plus noise encryption and yamux multiplexing.

nodes.name: resolveJoinTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves a domain join target by either decoding an inline multiaddr list from the discovery URL or fetching domain clusters from the discovery service.

nodes.name: fetchDiscoveryClusters
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses the cluster list from a discovery endpoint, normalizing manager and relay multiaddr arrays from the raw JSON response.

nodes.name: parseMembership
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a JSON membership payload into a typed Membership object, ensuring the peers array is present.

nodes.name: JsLibp2pBrowserPeer
nodes.summary: Primary browser peer class implementing the BrowserDomainPeer contract via js-libp2p: handles domain joining/leaving, participant observation, sensor declaration, audio streaming, and periodic membership refresh over the Auki control protocol.

nodes.name: Libp2pBrowserPeerTransport
nodes.summary: Wraps a js-libp2p node instance providing start/stop lifecycle, relay multiaddr management, and protocol handler/dialer abstraction used by JsLibp2pBrowserPeer.

nodes.name: createBrowserDomainPeer
nodes.summary: Top-level factory for the browser SDK peer: creates a JsLibp2pBrowserPeer when a seed is provided, falls back to a global factory or a closed-peer stub, and wraps the result in an SDK-session delegating adapter.

nodes.name: failClosedPeer
nodes.summary: Returns a closed-peer stub implementing the BrowserDomainPeer interface where all operations return a transport-unavailable error, used when no transport is configured.

nodes.name: wrapSdkSession
nodes.summary: Wraps an underlying SDK session (or shell peer) in an adapter that delegates all BrowserDomainPeer operations, merges remote participant data into local snapshots, and fires observer callbacks on state changes.

nodes.name: joinedSnapshotFromResult
nodes.summary: Builds a typed domain snapshot from a join result, ordering participants by membership peer list and merging local and remote participant records.

nodes.name: membershipPeerIds
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON membership payload and extracts an ordered list of peer ID strings, handling both snake_case and camelCase key formats.

nodes.name: encodeFrame
nodes.summary: Encodes a binary payload into a length-prefixed frame by prepending a 4-byte big-endian uint32 length header.

nodes.name: decodeFrame
nodes.summary: Decodes a length-prefixed binary frame, verifying the frame length against the uint32 header and returning the payload slice.

nodes.name: writeFrame
nodes.summary: Encodes and sends a typed protocol message over a ProtocolStream using the given codec, with back-pressure via onDrain.

nodes.name: readFrame
nodes.summary: Reads and decodes the next typed protocol message from a ProtocolStream using a FrameStreamReader and the given codec.

nodes.name: FrameStreamReader
nodes.summary: Buffers incoming async byte chunks from a ProtocolStream and provides a readFrame method that reassembles length-prefixed frames from the stream.

nodes.name: ProtoWriter
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled protobuf binary encoder supporting bool, string, bytes, uint64, and varint field types, accumulating chunks into a final byte array via finish().

nodes.name: ProtoReader
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled protobuf binary decoder that reads tag, varint, string, bytes, and skip operations from a Uint8Array to decode control protocol messages.

nodes.name: MemoryNetwork
nodes.summary: In-memory network stub for tests that manages MemoryTransport instances and simulates the dialProtocol handshake including optional dial failures.

nodes.name: MemoryTransport
nodes.summary: In-memory transport stub implementing the protocol transport interface with handleProtocol and dialProtocol methods backed by MemoryNetwork.

nodes.name: QueueStream
nodes.summary: Async queue-backed stream implementation used in tests to simulate bidirectional protocol stream communication between peers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Top-level package entry point for auki_datatypes that re-exports all sensor data type submodules (audio, camera, detection, joint_encoders, point_cloud, pose, stream, time_transform) under a unified namespace.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for the auki sub-package within auki_datatypes, marking the directory as a Python package.

nodes.name: audio.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Audio Data dataclass representing raw audio byte payloads for the Auki sensor data type system.

nodes.name: camera.py
nodes.summary: Defines DynamicIntrinsics (camera calibration parameters) and CameraFrame (a frame paired with its intrinsics) dataclasses for the Auki camera sensor data type.

nodes.name: detection.py
nodes.summary: Defines the DetectionFrame dataclass encapsulating raw detection data, a sensor hash, and detection type for the Auki detection sensor stream.

nodes.name: joint_encoders.py
nodes.summary: Defines the JointEncoders Data dataclass holding joint angle readings in radians for robotic or motion-capture sensor streams.

nodes.name: point_cloud.py
nodes.summary: Defines the PointCloud Data dataclass holding raw point cloud byte payloads for the Auki spatial sensor data type.

nodes.name: pose.py
nodes.summary: Defines SpatialTransform, Vec3, and Quat dataclasses representing 3D pose data (position and orientation) for the Auki spatial sensor type.

nodes.name: stream.py
nodes.summary: Defines the full streaming protocol type hierarchy including StreamRequest, StreamManifest, DeclineReason variants, EndReason variants, StreamEntry, and StreamMessage for the Auki sensor data stream protocol.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a tagged-union pattern via separate variant classes (e.g. DeclineReasonSensorNotFound, DeclineReasonOther) paired with a sum-type wrapper class, mirroring Rust enum-with-variants serialization.

nodes.name: time_transform.py
nodes.summary: Defines the TimeTransformEntry dataclass representing a clock synchronization entry with nanosecond offset and uncertainty for the Auki time-transform sensor stream.

nodes.name: test_locked_vectors.py
nodes.summary: Locked-vector wire-format regression tests and round-trip serialization tests for all auki_datatypes sensor types, ensuring binary encoding stability across SDK versions.

nodes.name: Data
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding raw audio bytes for an audio sensor frame.

nodes.name: DynamicIntrinsics
nodes.summary: Dataclass encoding per-frame camera intrinsics (focal lengths, principal point, distortion coefficients).

nodes.name: CameraFrame
nodes.summary: Dataclass pairing a raw image frame with its DynamicIntrinsics for the camera sensor stream.

nodes.name: DetectionFrame
nodes.summary: Dataclass encapsulating detection payload bytes, sensor hash, and detection type for a single detection sensor frame.

nodes.name: Data
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding an array of joint angles in radians for a joint encoder sensor reading.

nodes.name: Data
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding raw point cloud bytes for a spatial sensor frame.

nodes.name: SpatialTransform
nodes.summary: Dataclass composing a Vec3 translation and Quat orientation into a full 3D spatial transform.

nodes.name: Vec3
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing a 3D vector with x, y, z float components used for translations in spatial transforms.

nodes.name: Quat
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing a unit quaternion with x, y, z, w components used for orientations in spatial transforms.

nodes.name: StreamManifest
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing a stream's sensor, clock, and frame identities and hashes sent on stream acceptance.

nodes.name: StreamMessage
nodes.summary: Top-level sum-type wrapper for all stream protocol messages: request, accept, decline, entry, and end-of-stream variants.

nodes.name: DeclineReason
nodes.summary: Sum-type wrapper holding one of the stream decline reason variants when a stream request is rejected.

nodes.name: EndReason
nodes.summary: Sum-type wrapper holding one of the stream end reason variants when a stream terminates.

nodes.name: TimeTransformEntry
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing a single clock synchronization sample with nanosecond offset and uncertainty fields.

nodes.name: test_camera_frame_locked_wire_bytes
nodes.summary: Verifies that the wire-format encoding of a CameraFrame with DynamicIntrinsics matches a known-good hex string.

nodes.name: test_spatial_transform_locked_wire_bytes
nodes.summary: Verifies that the wire-format encoding of a SpatialTransform (Vec3 + Quat) matches a known-good hex string.

nodes.name: test_spatial_transform_round_trips
nodes.summary: Verifies that a SpatialTransform serialized to bytes and parsed back produces an identical object.

nodes.name: test_stream_manifest_round_trips
nodes.summary: Verifies that a StreamManifest serialized to bytes and parsed back produces an identical object.

nodes.name: test_module_re_exports_all_packages
nodes.summary: Verifies that the top-level auki_datatypes package correctly re-exports all expected sub-packages and their types.

nodes.name: error.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the `SessionError` enum covering all error variants that can arise during session operations, including I/O, invalid IDs, registry failures, duplicate logs, and materialization errors.

nodes.name: SessionError
nodes.summary: Enum representing the full set of errors that can occur in the auki-session crate, including I/O, invalid identifiers, registry, duplicate log, and materialization failure variants.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for `auki-session` that declares all submodules and re-exports their public items, providing the unified public surface for session, peer, log specification, log handle, materialization, registry store, and error types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust crate root using `pub mod` and `pub use` to re-export all submodule items as the crate's public API.

nodes.name: log_handles.rs
nodes.summary: Defines runtime handle structs (`SensorLogHandle`, `PoseLogHandle`, `TimeTransformLogHandle`, `DetectionLogHandle`, `MaterializedLogHandle`) returned when registering logs in a session, each carrying the resource ID, log reference, manifest, and head spec.

nodes.name: SensorLogHandle
nodes.summary: Handle returned after registering a sensor log; carries the resource ID, log reference, manifest, and head spec for subsequent writer use.

nodes.name: PoseLogHandle
nodes.summary: Handle returned after registering a pose log; extends the base handle with a `writer_mode` field to indicate movable or static pose writing.

nodes.name: TimeTransformLogHandle
nodes.summary: Handle returned after registering a time-transform log, carrying resource ID, log reference, manifest, and head spec for clock-domain conversion logs.

nodes.name: DetectionLogHandle
nodes.summary: Handle returned after registering a detection log, bundling the resource ID, log reference, manifest, and head spec for detector output logs.

nodes.name: MaterializedLogHandle
nodes.summary: Minimal handle for a materialized (remotely sourced) log, carrying only the log reference.

nodes.name: log_specs.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the specification structs (`HeadSpec`, `SensorLogSpec`, `PoseLogSpec`, `TimeTransformLogSpec`, `DetectionLogSpec`) used as input parameters when registering logs in a session, describing retention, segmentation, and data-source configuration.

nodes.name: HeadSpec
nodes.summary: Enum specifying the log head policy: `Rolling` (fixed-duration sliding window) or `Fixed` (retain all data).

nodes.name: SensorLogSpec
nodes.summary: Specification for creating a sensor data log, including sensor reference, clock, coordinate frame, head policy, segment duration, and retention period.

nodes.name: PoseLogSpec
nodes.summary: Specification for creating a pose (transform) log between two coordinate frames, including source, writer mode, expected rate, head policy, and retention.

nodes.name: TimeTransformLogSpec
nodes.summary: Specification for a time-transform log that records the mapping between two clock domains, including source, head policy, segment duration, and retention.

nodes.name: DetectionLogSpec
nodes.summary: Specification for a detection log linking a detector to its input sensor log and clock, with retention and segmentation configuration.

nodes.name: materialization.rs
nodes.summary: Defines `MaterializationError`, the error enum for remote log materialization failures, covering not-found, connection, and not-implemented variants.

nodes.name: MaterializationError
nodes.summary: Enum representing errors from remote log materialization: `NotFound`, `Connection`, and `NotImplemented`.

nodes.name: peer.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `Peer` struct representing a local SDK participant, providing methods to register coordinate frames, sensors, and detectors to the registry, manage storage root, and start sessions; also defines `FrameDef` for coordinate-frame conventions and `PeerRegistries` for read-only access to registered entities.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Arc<RwLock<PeerInner>> for interior mutability, allowing `Peer` to be cheaply cloned and shared across threads.

nodes.name: Peer
nodes.summary: Core peer identity and registration API: creates and configures a peer, registers frames/sensors/detectors to on-disk registries, and vends sessions via `start_session`.

nodes.name: FrameDef
nodes.summary: Enum with constructor helpers for the four supported coordinate-frame conventions (ROS body, ROS optical, OpenGL, Unity), each converting into a registry entry via `into_entry`.

nodes.name: PeerRegistries
nodes.summary: Read-only view into a peer's registered sensors, frames, and detectors, returned by `Peer::registries()`.

nodes.name: register_frame
nodes.summary: Validates a frame ID, converts the `FrameDef` to a registry entry, writes it to disk, and stores it in the peer's in-memory frame map; returns a reference to the stored entry.

nodes.name: register_sensor
nodes.summary: Validates a sensor ID, builds a sensor registry entry from the given body, writes it to disk, and inserts it into the peer's sensor map.

nodes.name: register_detector
nodes.summary: Validates a detector ID, writes a detector registry entry to disk (including output type declarations), and stores it in the peer's detector map.

nodes.name: start_session
nodes.summary: Delegates to `Session::start` with the peer's inner state, creating and returning a new `Session` instance.

nodes.name: registry_store.rs
nodes.summary: Provides `RegistryStore<E>`, a generic ordered in-memory store for registry entries (sensors, frames, detectors, clocks) backed by a `HashMap`, with `insert`, `get`, and `iter` operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over entry type `E` using a HashMap keyed by string ID; implements `Default` for zero-cost initialization.

nodes.name: RegistryStore
nodes.summary: Generic in-memory map of registry entries keyed by string ID, providing `default`, `insert`, `get`, and `iter` methods used by Peer and Session to manage sensors, frames, detectors, and clocks.

nodes.name: session.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the `Session` struct that represents an active data-collection session for a peer: initializes monotonic and UTC clocks, and provides methods to register sensor, pose, time-transform, and detection logs with full validation, manifest writing, and disk persistence; also defines `SessionLogs` for read-only log enumeration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Arc<RwLock<SessionInner>> for shared mutable state; all log registration methods write manifests to disk via `write_manifest` and store handles as Arc-wrapped values.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Central session object that owns the session's clock registries and log maps; exposes `register_*_log` methods for all log types and provides read-only accessors for peer identity, session ID, and storage root.

nodes.name: SessionLogs
nodes.summary: Snapshot view of all log handles registered in a session, providing typed accessors for sensor, pose, time-transform, and detection log collections.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Static constructor for `Session`: generates a ULID session ID, registers the built-in monotonic and UTC clocks to disk and registry, and initializes the session's inner state.

nodes.name: register_sensor_log
nodes.summary: Validates the referenced sensor is registered on this peer, checks for duplicate log IDs, builds a sensor log manifest, writes it to disk, and returns a `SensorLogHandle`.

nodes.name: register_pose_log
nodes.summary: Checks for duplicate pose log IDs, builds a pose log manifest encoding the from/to frame and writer mode, writes it to disk, and returns a `PoseLogHandle`.

nodes.name: register_time_transform_log
nodes.summary: Registers a time-transform log mapping two clock domains; validates uniqueness, writes manifest to disk, and returns a `TimeTransformLogHandle`.

nodes.name: register_detection_log
nodes.summary: Registers a detection log linking a detector to its sensor input; validates uniqueness, writes manifest, and returns a `DetectionLogHandle`.

nodes.name: write_and_store_clock
nodes.summary: Free function that validates a clock ID, builds a clock registry entry, writes it to disk via `auki_registry::write_clock`, and inserts it into the provided clock store.

nodes.name: write_manifest
nodes.summary: Helper that creates the on-disk directory path for a log manifest, serializes the manifest to JSON canonical form (JCS), and writes the file.

nodes.name: app_state.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the DiagnosticApp struct that owns the runtime, flash event log, and sound engine, acting as the central app state for the egui-based diagnostic GUI. Implements the eframe App trait to drive the per-frame update loop.

nodes.name: DiagnosticApp
nodes.summary: Central application state struct holding the SdkRuntime handle, snapshot cache, flash event log, sound engine, and UI input buffers. Exposes a command API to the UI layer and implements the eframe App trait.

nodes.name: FlashEventLog
nodes.summary: Bounded ring-buffer that records flash on/off rising-edge timestamps for display in the diagnostics event log, capped at a maximum number of entries.

nodes.name: flash.rs
nodes.summary: Provides pure timing utilities for the flash synchronization protocol: UTC timestamp retrieval, period boundary calculations, flash-on predicates, simulated UTC offset application, and a FlashMode enum distinguishing UTC vs. Domain flash modes.

nodes.name: FlashMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting between UTC-clock-based and Domain-clock-based flash synchronization modes.

nodes.name: flash_is_on
nodes.summary: Returns whether the flash LED should be on at a given nanosecond timestamp given a period and on-duration, used to drive both UI rendering and tick-report publication.

nodes.name: apply_simulated_utc_offset_ns
nodes.summary: Applies a signed millisecond offset to a nanosecond UTC timestamp to simulate clock skew for diagnostic testing purposes.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Binary entry point for the Auki Diagnostics egui/eframe application; constructs the viewport, native options, and instantiates DiagnosticApp to start the event loop.

nodes.name: sdk_runtime.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the SdkRuntime facade and its background RuntimeWorker, managing the Auki peer lifecycle (identity, swarm, domain join/leave), cluster snapshot maintenance, and tick-report broadcasting over a Tokio runtime spawned on a dedicated thread.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Arc<Mutex<RuntimeSnapshot>> shared between the UI thread and the Tokio worker; a JoinGeneration atomic counter prevents stale join callbacks from applying to a newer join attempt.

nodes.name: RuntimeSnapshot
nodes.summary: Value-type snapshot of all observable runtime state (peer ID, role, cluster info, domain time, flash mode) that is cloned and handed to the UI on each frame.

nodes.name: SdkRuntime
nodes.summary: UI-thread handle to the async runtime worker; exposes spawn(), send(), and snapshot() to the app state and routes commands to the background worker via an unbounded channel.

nodes.name: RuntimeWorker
nodes.summary: Background Tokio task that owns the Domain session, processes RuntimeCommands, manages cluster join/leave flows, ingests remote diagnostic messages, and publishes tick reports.

nodes.name: RuntimeCommand
nodes.summary: Enum of all commands the UI can issue to the runtime (configuration updates, join/leave, flash mode, tick report publication, and cluster lifecycle callbacks).

nodes.name: apply_command
nodes.summary: Applies a RuntimeCommand to the RuntimeSnapshot, updating all relevant fields including cluster membership, domain time, peer rows, and join-in-flight status.

nodes.name: join_or_create
nodes.summary: Core async join flow: loads or mints identity seed, builds the libp2p swarm, waits for routable addresses, starts a Domain session, joins the cluster, and installs a shutdown-on-leave handler.

nodes.name: ingest_diagnostic_messages
nodes.summary: Drains broadcast diagnostic messages from the cluster manager, deserializes incoming TickReports, and records them in the store before publishing updated peer stats.

nodes.name: sound.rs
nodes.summary: Wraps the cpal/rodio audio output stack to provide a fire-and-forget beep API used to audibly signal flash rising edges, with graceful degradation when audio is unavailable.

nodes.name: SoundEngine
nodes.summary: Holds an optional cpal OutputStream and OutputStreamHandle; exposes beep() to play a short sine-wave tone, and availability query methods for conditional UI rendering.

nodes.name: tick_report.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the TickReport wire format, the TickReportStore that accumulates local and remote reports, and statistical computation (per-peer p50/p95/max deltas and improvement ratio) for the sync-quality panel.

nodes.name: TickReport
nodes.summary: Serializable message broadcast by each peer on every flash tick, carrying peer identity, tick ID, flash mode, and UTC/domain observed timestamps.

nodes.name: TickReportStore
nodes.summary: Bounded store separating local and remote TickReport histories; computes per-peer sync statistics aggregated across all tracked reports.

nodes.name: peer_stats
nodes.summary: Computes PeerTickStats for every tracked remote peer by matching tick IDs against local reports, computing UTC and domain delta distributions, and deriving an improvement ratio.

nodes.name: deltas_for_mode
nodes.summary: Pairs remote tick reports with the nearest preceding local report of matching tick ID and flash mode, computing the absolute nanosecond delta rounded to one decimal millisecond.

nodes.name: ui.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the egui rendering layer for the diagnostic app: sidebar configuration controls, flash visualizer, sync-quality statistics table, and bottom event/flash-event log panels.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Top-level render entry point that composes the sidebar, status strip, flash panel, sync-quality panel, and bottom diagnostics panel into the egui frame.

nodes.name: render_flash_panel
nodes.summary: Renders the main flash panel including mode selectors, sound toggle, simulated offset controls, timing readouts, a custom painted flash indicator, and drives tick-report publication each frame.

nodes.name: render_sidebar
nodes.summary: Renders the left sidebar with peer identity display, display-name/cluster-name/discovery-URL text inputs that dispatch RuntimeCommands on change, and Join/Leave cluster buttons.

nodes.name: render_sync_quality_panel
nodes.summary: Renders a striped egui grid displaying per-peer UTC and domain sync delta statistics (latest, p95, improvement ratio, sample count) from the tick report store.

nodes.name: browser_session.rs
nodes.summary: Provides WASM-friendly domain session and result types for browser environments, wrapping peer identity access and representing join outcomes as JavaScript-serializable structs.

nodes.name: BrowserDomainSession
nodes.summary: Represents an active domain session in a browser/WASM context, exposing peer ID and identity accessors and a transport_unavailable error factory.

nodes.name: BrowserDomainResult
nodes.summary: JS-serializable result type for browser domain join outcomes, carrying an optional session value or an error on failure.

nodes.name: cluster_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Core cluster lifecycle engine: creates, joins, and manages p2p domain clusters with discovery, relay support, heartbeat-based liveness, manager election/step-down, and resource/registry/clock services.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensively uses Arc<Mutex<>> for shared async state, tokio tasks for background handlers, and async fn throughout; the file is the largest single source of logic in the crate at ~5100 lines.

nodes.name: ClusterManager
nodes.summary: Primary handle for an active cluster connection: exposes membership queries, peer admission, stream opening, participant info, domain-clock access, and resource/registry fetch operations.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.summary: Entry point for joining or creating a cluster based on ClusterTarget strategy (Create, Join, JoinOrCreate, MostRecentOrCreate); delegates to create_cluster or join_cluster as needed.

nodes.name: create_cluster_with_relay_hints
nodes.summary: Full cluster creation path: registers with discovery, initialises session/domain clocks, spawns all background handlers (liveness, join, membership, info, resources, registry, diagnostic), and returns a ClusterManager.

nodes.name: join_cluster
nodes.summary: Connects to an existing cluster via discovery, negotiates join with the manager peer, synchronises membership, and starts all background runtime tasks.

nodes.name: handle_domain_peer_lost
nodes.summary: Reacts to a peer departure: triggers manager re-election or step-down, refreshes heartbeat watchlists, and handles manager relay re-registration when the lost peer was the manager.

nodes.name: spawn_liveness_handler
nodes.summary: Spawns the async background task that monitors heartbeat liveness events and delegates to handle_domain_peer_lost on peer loss.

nodes.name: spawn_manager_liveness_check
nodes.summary: Periodically polls discovery to verify the current manager's liveness and initiates step-down or re-election when the manager is found missing.

nodes.name: admit_peer
nodes.summary: Manager-only: accepts a join request from a candidate peer, adds it to the membership roster, and broadcasts the updated membership to the cluster.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Gracefully tears down all background handler tasks, sets the stopped flag, and aborts the network runtime.

nodes.name: ClusterTarget
nodes.summary: Enum describing the bootstrap strategy: Create a new cluster, Join an existing one, JoinOrCreate, or MostRecentOrCreate for convenience.

nodes.name: BootstrapError
nodes.summary: Error enum covering all failure modes of cluster bootstrap: discovery failure, already-exists/not-found, send failures, rejection, invalid membership, runtime error, and relay reservation failure.

nodes.name: cluster_membership.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the in-memory cluster membership roster: a list of ClusterMember records with peer IDs, multiaddrs, and join timestamps, plus admission logic.

nodes.name: ClusterMembership
nodes.summary: Thread-safe membership roster for a domain cluster, supporting peer admission and serialisation to/from discovery format.

nodes.name: domain.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level Domain type that wraps a ClusterManager and exposes a DomainCatalog for reading sensor, pose, time-transform, and detection log data from the network.

nodes.name: Domain
nodes.summary: High-level handle for a joined domain: provides join/leave lifecycle, access to the underlying ClusterManager, and catalog queries for data streams.

nodes.name: DomainCatalog
nodes.summary: Provides typed accessors for catalog rows (sensor, pose, time-transform, detection log) fetched from the domain registry via the ClusterManager.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for auki-domain: re-exports all public modules (browser_session, cluster_manager, cluster_membership, domain, stream_manifest) as the public API surface.

nodes.name: stream_manifest.rs
nodes.summary: Builds a StreamManifest from registry catalog entries, mapping sensor/frame/detector/clock definitions into a typed manifest structure consumed by stream consumers.

nodes.name: StreamManifestBuilder
nodes.summary: Incrementally assembles a StreamManifest from raw registry entries (sensors, frames, detectors, clocks) fetched from a domain peer.

nodes.name: smoke_browser_full_peer_audio.mjs
nodes.summary: End-to-end browser smoke test that verifies two headless Chromium peers can join a domain via a Rust manager+relay pair, publish generated audio, subscribe to it, and confirm live WebRTC audio playback using Playwright.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level await (ESM) drives the entire test orchestration; Playwright headless Chromium is launched against a local Node.js HTTP server that serves the WASM/JS bundle with the required COOP/COEP headers for SharedArrayBuffer.

nodes.name: chromeExecutable
nodes.summary: Resolves the path to an available Chrome or Chromium executable by checking a prioritised list of common install locations, returning undefined if none is found.

nodes.name: preferLoopback
nodes.summary: Address-selection helper that prefers a loopback multiaddr (/ip4/127.0.0.1/) over any previously seen address, enabling deterministic local test connectivity.

nodes.name: smoke_browser_full_peer_probe.mjs
nodes.summary: End-to-end browser smoke test that launches two headless Chromium peers against a Rust manager+relay, verifies they join a domain as full libp2p peers (not browser-session fallback), and confirms mutual participant visibility via domain state snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: Structurally identical to the audio smoke test but exercises the probe path (runFullPeerProbe) and asserts participant discovery rather than audio delivery.

nodes.name: chromeExecutable
nodes.summary: Resolves the path to an available Chrome or Chromium executable by checking a prioritised list of common install locations, returning undefined if none is found.

nodes.name: preferLoopback
nodes.summary: Address-selection helper that prefers a loopback multiaddr (/ip4/127.0.0.1/) over any previously seen address, enabling deterministic local test connectivity.

nodes.name: smoke_freshness.mjs
nodes.summary: Exports a single guard function that aborts a smoke test early when the compiled pkg-web WASM artifact is missing or older than any of its Rust source files, ensuring the smoke tests never silently run against stale build output.

nodes.name: assertFreshPkgWeb
nodes.summary: Checks that a given pkg-web artifact exists and has a newer mtime than all specified source files; throws a descriptive error listing stale sources and the command to rebuild if the check fails.

nodes.name: smoke_freshness.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js built-in test suite for assertFreshPkgWeb, covering the stale-artifact rejection case and the fresh-artifact acceptance case using temporary directories and manipulated file mtimes.

nodes.name: browser_audio.rs
nodes.summary: Provides audio format conversion utilities for the browser WASM peer, converting between IEEE 754 f32 PCM samples and 16-bit signed little-endian (S16LE) bytes, plus a test tone generator for smoke testing.

nodes.name: f32_to_s16le
nodes.summary: Converts a slice of f32 float audio samples (range -1.0..1.0) into raw S16LE PCM bytes, clamping values and extending a caller-provided output buffer.

nodes.name: s16le_to_f32
nodes.summary: Decodes raw S16LE PCM bytes into a Vec of f32 samples, returning an error if the input length is not a multiple of 2.

nodes.name: generated_audio_frame
nodes.summary: Generates a 20 ms 440 Hz sine-wave audio frame as S16LE bytes, indexed by frame number, used for deterministic smoke testing of the audio pipeline.

nodes.name: browser_full_peer.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the browser-side full libp2p peer (`BrowserFullPeer`) that joins a domain via a circuit-relay, manages the participant roster, handles inbound audio streams, and coordinates WebRTC/WebSocket transport setup using `libp2p`.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Rc<RefCell<_>> throughout for single-threaded interior mutability compatible with the WASM single-threaded executor. The libp2p SwarmBuilder is configured with WebRTC-websys and WebSocket-websys transports with circuit-relay for browser NAT traversal.

nodes.name: BrowserFullPeer
nodes.summary: Central browser peer state holder managing identity, member roster, audio publication mode, and stream control; drives domain join via circuit relay and handles inbound audio stream requests.

nodes.name: BrowserPeerDebugState
nodes.summary: Serializable debug snapshot of the browser peer containing session usage flag, advertised multiaddrs, and roster peer count.

nodes.name: BrowserPeerMember
nodes.summary: Represents a peer in the browser membership roster, carrying peer ID string, multiaddrs, and an optional participant descriptor.

nodes.name: BrowserAudioPublication
nodes.summary: Enum controlling the browser peer's audio publication mode: Off, Generated (test tone), or Microphone.

nodes.name: join_via_relayed_peer
nodes.summary: Builds a full libp2p swarm with WebRTC+WebSocket transports and circuit relay, dials the relay, listens on a circuit address to obtain an advertised multiaddr, then dials all roster members and sets up the stream protocol accept loop.

nodes.name: handle_inbound_stream
nodes.summary: Processes an inbound libp2p stream request: reads the request, determines the audio publication mode, accepts or declines the stream, then enters a frame-sending loop dispatching generated audio frames with timestamps.

nodes.name: apply_membership_json
nodes.summary: Parses JSON membership data from the manager and updates the internal roster map, merging in the local participant descriptor for the self entry.

nodes.name: roster_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds a `SessionSnapshot` from the current roster, mapping each member to a participant descriptor for the JS-observable state.

nodes.name: browser_stream.rs
nodes.summary: Provides low-level length-prefixed framing helpers (`write_message`, `read_message`) for encoding and decoding protobuf `StreamMessage` values over a libp2p async stream.

nodes.name: write_message
nodes.summary: Encodes a protobuf message to bytes, validates a size limit, writes a 4-byte big-endian length prefix followed by the payload, and flushes the stream.

nodes.name: read_message
nodes.summary: Reads a 4-byte big-endian length prefix then the exact payload from a libp2p stream, decoding the bytes into a `StreamMessage` protobuf.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Root crate library for the `auki-network-browser-wasm` WebAssembly SDK: exposes the `BrowserDomainSession` wasm-bindgen class for joining and managing Auki domains from a browser, implements discovery, relay-based join/probe flows, sensor subscription, and audio streaming over libp2p.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavily uses wasm-bindgen and wasm_bindgen_futures::spawn_local for bridging async Rust to the browser's single-threaded event loop. Rc<RefCell<_>> is the shared-state primitive throughout since Send is not required in WASM. The libp2p SwarmBuilder pattern is repeated for both session and join/probe dial paths.

nodes.name: BrowserDomainSession
nodes.summary: Primary wasm-bindgen exported class representing a browser peer's session; exposes domain lifecycle (join/leave), participant observation, sensor declaration and publication, and audio subscription to JavaScript callers.

nodes.name: BrowserDomainSessionState
nodes.summary: Internal shared state for a browser domain session: holds peer ID, metadata, sensor list, media presence, snapshot, observer callbacks, and a message sender to the async session task.

nodes.name: BrowserJoinResult
nodes.summary: Serializable join result returned to JS callers after a manager dial, carrying success/failure flag, peer IDs, membership JSON, and successor token.

nodes.name: BrowserProbeResult
nodes.summary: Serializable probe result returned to JS callers after a dial-probe operation, carrying success flag, local peer ID, protocol, and payload or error string.

nodes.name: start_browser_session
nodes.summary: Fetches the discovery cluster, resolves manager and relay addresses, builds the libp2p swarm with WebRTC+WebSocket transports and relay, dials the manager, processes join/leave commands from the session channel, and continuously forwards roster snapshots to the session state.

nodes.name: dial_browser_join_inner
nodes.summary: Builds a dedicated libp2p swarm for the join handshake, dials the manager via relay, performs the stream protocol exchange to receive a join accept/reject, and returns a `BrowserJoinResult`.

nodes.name: fetch_browser_discovery_cluster
nodes.summary: Queries the Auki discovery endpoint via the browser's `fetch` API, parses the JSON response into a `BrowserDiscoveryList`, and returns the cluster entry matching the requested domain name.

nodes.name: subscribe_audio_stream
nodes.summary: Opens an outbound libp2p stream to a remote peer, sends a sensor subscription request, awaits the accept/decline response, then loops reading audio entry frames and computing output levels.

nodes.name: join_domain
nodes.summary: Exported wasm-bindgen method on `BrowserDomainSession` that initiates a domain join via discovery, applies the resulting roster snapshot, and serializes the result for JS.

nodes.name: dial_browser_probe_inner
nodes.summary: Builds a probe-specific libp2p swarm using a custom probe behaviour, dials the manager, exchanges a probe message, and returns a `BrowserProbeResult` with the server response.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: PyO3 crate root for the auki-network Python extension module, exposing the discovery client API (cluster listing, creation, liveness checks, manager rotation, deregistration) as Python classes and registering the stream_types submodule.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PyO3 #[pymodule] + #[pyclass] macros with a dedicated tokio Runtime (OnceLock singleton) to bridge async Rust discovery-client calls to synchronous Python via py.allow_threads.

nodes.name: PyClusterEntry
nodes.summary: Python-facing wrapper around a Rust ClusterEntry, exposing cluster name, manager peer ID, multiaddrs, relay multiaddrs, peer count, and creation/liveness timestamps as Python properties.

nodes.name: PyCreateClusterOutcome
nodes.summary: Python-facing result type for cluster creation, carrying an is_already_exists flag and an optional PyClusterEntry.

nodes.name: PyDiscoveryClient
nodes.summary: Python-facing discovery client wrapping the async Rust DiscoveryClient, providing synchronous methods for listing clusters, creating, rotating the manager, performing liveness checks, and deregistering.

nodes.name: stream_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Provides PyAsyncIterStream, a Rust async Stream adapter that drives a Python async iterator on a dedicated asyncio event loop thread, enabling Rust code to consume Python async generators as Rust futures.
nodes.languageNotes: Spins up a Python asyncio event loop on a daemon thread at first use (OnceLock) and uses pyo3_async_runtimes::into_future_with_locals to bridge Python coroutines into Rust futures.

nodes.name: asyncio_locals
nodes.summary: Returns a lazily-initialized TaskLocals singleton that owns a background asyncio event loop running on a daemon thread, used to drive Python coroutines from Rust async context.

nodes.name: PyAsyncIterStream
nodes.summary: Async Rust wrapper around a Python async iterable object, exposing next() and aclose() as async Rust methods that schedule __anext__ / aclose coroutines on the background asyncio loop.

nodes.name: stream_types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines all PyO3 sensor-stream types for the auki-network Python extension: frame payloads (camera, point cloud, joint encoders, audio, spatial transform), stream request/manifest, decline/end reasons, stream items, subscriptions, entry iterators, and the stream provider build logic.
nodes.languageNotes: This file is the bulk of the Python binding (~2700 non-empty lines) and uses a multi-variant StreamPayload enum to unify five sensor modalities into a single PyO3-compatible payload container.

nodes.name: PyStreamRequest
nodes.summary: Python-facing stream request carrying a resource ID and source peer ID, used by Python callers to request a sensor stream.

nodes.name: PyStreamManifest
nodes.summary: Python-facing stream manifest describing a sensor source: sensor/clock/frame identifiers, resource ID, payload type, writer mode, expected rate, and pose-stream factory method.

nodes.name: PyDynamicIntrinsics
nodes.summary: Python-facing camera intrinsics (fx, fy, cx, cy, distortion coefficients) for per-frame dynamic calibration data.

nodes.name: PyCameraFrame
nodes.summary: Python-facing camera frame carrying raw image bytes and optional dynamic intrinsics.

nodes.name: PyPointCloudFrame
nodes.summary: Python-facing point cloud frame wrapping raw point cloud bytes with __len__ and bytes accessor.

nodes.name: PyJointEncodersFrame
nodes.summary: Python-facing joint encoder frame holding a vector of joint angles in radians.

nodes.name: PyAudioFrame
nodes.summary: Python-facing audio frame wrapping raw audio bytes with __len__ and data accessor.

nodes.name: PySpatialTransformFrame
nodes.summary: Python-facing spatial transform frame carrying a 7-element (translation + quaternion) float64 array for pose data.

nodes.name: PyDeclineReason
nodes.summary: Python-facing enum-like type representing why a stream request was declined (sensor not found, unavailable, producer shutting down, or custom detail).

nodes.name: PyEndReason
nodes.summary: Python-facing enum-like type representing why a stream ended (source ended, producer shutting down, session ended, or producer error with detail).

nodes.name: StreamPayload
nodes.summary: Internal Rust enum unifying all five sensor payload variants (Camera, PointCloud, JointEncoders, Audio, Pose) with from_py/into_py conversion helpers for PyO3 boundary crossing.

nodes.name: PyStreamItem
nodes.summary: Python-facing stream item produced by Python-side stream providers, carrying a timestamp and a typed payload; provides to_rust_* conversion methods for each sensor modality.

nodes.name: PyStreamEntry
nodes.summary: Python-facing stream entry received by Python subscribers, carrying a sequence number, timestamp, and a typed payload; provides from_rust_* factory methods for each sensor modality.

nodes.name: PyStreamDecision
nodes.summary: Python-facing stream decision object passed to the stream provider callback, allowing Python code to accept (with a typed source or retained source) or decline a stream request.

nodes.name: build_stream_provider
nodes.summary: Constructs a Rust StreamProvider from a Python callable, bridging the Python decision callback into the Rust provider trait by dispatching each incoming stream request through the Python callable and converting the decision result.

nodes.name: retained_log_into_source_stream
nodes.summary: Converts a retained-log source (historical + tail iterators) into a Rust source stream, replaying historical entries then switching to live tail entries.

nodes.name: python_iter_into_source_stream
nodes.summary: Converts a Python async iterator of PyStreamItem objects into a Rust source stream by polling the iterator via PyAsyncIterStream and applying a per-modality conversion function.

nodes.name: PyStreamSubscription
nodes.summary: Python-facing subscription handle returned when subscribing to a stream, holding the stream manifest and an iterator over entries; constructed from Rust subscription types for each sensor modality.

nodes.name: PyStreamEntryIterator
nodes.summary: Python iterator over stream entries (implements __iter__/__next__), blocking on Rust async stream using a tokio runtime and translating Rust results to Python PyStreamEntry objects.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers all stream type PyO3 classes into a Python submodule, acting as the entry point called by lib.rs to populate the streams submodule.

nodes.name: wiki-mirror.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that automatically mirrors the docs/wiki/ directory to the GitHub Wiki on every push to develop, using rsync to keep wiki content in sync with the source repository.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses concurrency group with cancel-in-progress to ensure only the latest push wins when multiple pushes land in quick succession.

nodes.name: connected.html
nodes.summary: Minimal brainstorm placeholder page confirming that the visual companion is connected and ready for UI mockups and timing-test diagrams for the Auki Diagnostic App.

nodes.name: egui-diagnostic-layout.html
nodes.summary: First-pass HTML mockup of the Auki Diagnostic App native window layout, showing a two-column egui-style UI with peer identity/cluster controls on the left and live diagnostic panels (networking status, heartbeat, clock offset, synchronized flash, peer list, events) on the right, with A/B approve/revise options.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline-styled HTML fragment used as a superpowers brainstorm content slide; not a standalone page.

nodes.name: egui-diagnostic-layout-v2.html
nodes.summary: Revised version of the Auki Diagnostic App layout mockup that changes peer ID display to show only the last six characters (suffix) instead of the opening characters, addressing the issue that leading characters are usually identical across peers.

nodes.name: audio.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the opaque-bytes audio payload message (`auki.audio.Data`) used as both the on-disk Sensor Log segment payload and the on-wire libp2p `/auki/stream/0.2.0` payload for audio sensor streams. Interpretation metadata (sample format, channels, rate) lives in the SensorRegistryEntry, not the per-chunk message.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses opaque `bytes` field to keep the SDK format-agnostic; sample count and chunk duration are derivable from registry metadata rather than being stored redundantly per chunk.

nodes.name: camera.proto
nodes.summary: Defines per-frame camera log payload messages (`auki.camera.CameraFrame`, `auki.camera.DynamicIntrinsics`) used as the segment payload for camera Sensor Logs. `DynamicIntrinsics` is inline-optional to support autofocusing cameras that change intrinsics per frame while static cameras pay only ~1 byte overhead.
nodes.languageNotes: The optional `DynamicIntrinsics` field avoids a sibling sub-stream while remaining forward-compatible — the field number is reserved if the design later migrates to a separate intrinsics-update log.

nodes.name: detection.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the opaque-bytes detection log payload message (`auki.detection.DetectionFrame`) for per-frame outputs from Detector bindings (QR, ESL, person, etc.). Uses an open-string `type` discriminator field and a `sensor_hash` back-reference so consumers can select the correct per-type decoder without the SDK knowing any detector's schema.
nodes.languageNotes: Open-string `type` field (field 3, added Cuba T12) enables extensible detector discrimination without enum-locking the SDK. The `sensor_hash` (field 2, Cuba T5) cross-references the originating sensor registry entry.

nodes.name: info.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the request/response messages (`auki.info.InfoRequest`, `auki.info.InfoResponse`) for the libp2p `/auki/info/0.0.1` substream protocol. The response carries participant info as a JSON string, keeping the binary schema minimal.

nodes.name: join.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the request/response messages (`auki.join.JoinRequest`, `auki.join.JoinResponse`) for the libp2p `/auki/join/0.0.1` substream protocol. The response uses a `oneof` discriminator to carry either an `Accept` (with membership JSON and successor token) or a `Reject` (with a reason string).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nested message types inside `JoinResponse` for `Accept` and `Reject` variants, keeping the oneof semantics clean without separate top-level types.

nodes.name: joint_encoders.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the joint-encoder sensor payload message (`auki.joint_encoders.Data`) carrying a repeated float vector of joint angle readings in radians. The vector length is fixed per stream by the SensorRegistryEntry's `joint_count`; forward kinematics is a consumer-side concern.

nodes.name: point_cloud.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the opaque-bytes point-cloud payload message (`auki.point_cloud.Data`) carrying raw CDR `sensor_msgs/PointCloud2` bytes for Sensor Logs and libp2p streams. Layout metadata (fields, point_step, endianness) lives in the SensorRegistryEntry's `PointCloud` body.

nodes.name: pose.proto
nodes.summary: Defines spatial mathematics primitives (`auki.pose.SpatialTransform`, `Vec3`, `Quat`) used as the per-sample payload for Pose Log segments. Each log entry is one flat `SpatialTransform` keyed to a single `(from_frame_id, to_frame_id)` pair on the manifest, eliminating per-sample frame redundancy.
nodes.languageNotes: Quaternion uses Hamilton convention `(x, y, z, w)` matching ROS `geometry_msgs/Quaternion`. Producers SHOULD normalize before writing; consumers SHOULD tolerate small drift.

nodes.name: stream.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the full libp2p `/auki/stream/0.2.0` substream protocol envelope including `StreamRequest`, `StreamManifest`, `StreamEntry`, `DeclineReason`, `EndReason`, and the top-level `StreamMessage` discriminator union. This is the core wire protocol for all sensor data streaming in the Auki network.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a top-level `StreamMessage` oneof to multiplex request/accept/decline/entry/end_of_stream on a single substream. `DeclineReason` and `EndReason` each use nested oneofs with typed sub-messages for exhaustive variant discrimination.

nodes.name: time_transform.proto
nodes.summary: Defines the per-sample TimeTransform Log payload message (`auki.time_transform.TimeTransformEntry`) carrying a signed `offset_ns` (clock delta) and unsigned `uncertainty_ns` (measurement window). The `(from_clock_id, to_clock_id)` key and transform source live on the manifest; discontinuity detection is left to the reader.
nodes.languageNotes: Omits the legacy `discontinuous: bool` field deliberately — baking one writer's threshold into on-disk bytes was rejected; readers compute discontinuity against their own threshold from the delta between consecutive `offset_ns` values.

nodes.name: ReadFromLatest
nodes.summary: Empty marker message selecting the latest-entry read position for a StreamRequest.

nodes.name: ReadFromStart
nodes.summary: Empty marker message selecting the start-of-stream read position for a StreamRequest.

nodes.name: ReadFromTimestamp
nodes.summary: Message carrying a nanosecond timestamp for seeking a stream to a specific point in time for a StreamRequest.

nodes.name: StreamRequest
nodes.summary: Wire message sent by a stream consumer to request data from a specific sensor or resource, identifying the source peer and the read-from position.

nodes.name: StreamManifest
nodes.summary: Accept handshake message sent by a producer containing sensor/resource identity, frame references, payload type, writer mode, and expected rate — the single source of truth for interpreting subsequent StreamEntry payloads.

nodes.name: StreamEntry
nodes.summary: Per-frame data message carrying a nanosecond timestamp, sequence number, and opaque payload bytes for a streaming sensor data record.

nodes.name: StreamMessage
nodes.summary: Top-level multiplexed message discriminating all stream protocol variants (request, accept, decline, entry, end_of_stream) over a single libp2p substream.
